notes: * Redesigned dashboard on every platform: the theme that's on now sits at the top, previews lead the marketplace, extensions are a list, settings are grouped.
+ Colour editor: type hex values and reset a single colour.
+ Custom CSS editor with line numbers and a check for unclosed braces.
+ Undo after removing a theme, extension or snippet.
* Quest: bigger text and targets in the dashboard.
+ Join the Discord button in Spectra's dashboard, on every platform.
* Stronger fix for music pausing during Meta and Discord calls: Spectra ignores the system's pause during a call and restarts the music if it stops on its own.
* Music keeps playing during Meta and Discord calls on Quest. Spectra no longer pauses when a call starts.
+ Room browser: find public Listen Together rooms and join with one click. Private rooms stay hidden and need their code.
+ DJs: the host can make anyone a DJ. DJs can add songs to the queue, play playlists and albums, skip and pause, or right-click any song or playlist in Spotify.
+ Listen Together has its own headphones button in Spotify's top bar.
* After updating, Spotify refreshes itself, or shows a Reload button if music is playing.
+ Listen Together: create a room from the Spectra button in Spotify and share the six-letter code. Friends who join hear what you play, at the same moment.
+ Pauses, seeks and song changes follow the host, and anyone who drifts out of sync is nudged back.
+ Works between the browser, desktop and Quest. Everyone plays on their own Spotify account.
* The Spectra (palette) button works again. Spotify's new top bar was blocking clicks and taps on it.
* Themes can no longer squeeze or hide the button. It now sits on the right of Spotify's top bar, and floats on top if a theme covers it.
* Quest: the app's own Spectra button appears whenever the one in Spotify can't be tapped.
+ Spectra for Mac (macOS 12 and newer, Apple silicon and Intel) and Linux (AppImage and .deb).
+ Extensions page on the website: browse every Spicetify extension and Spectra's featured picks.
+ Featured snippets: hand-picked CSS tweaks at the top of the Snippets tab.
* The Spectra button no longer disappears when a theme hides Spotify's top bar (Quest, desktop and web).
* Spectra has a new home: usespectra.xyz. Old links keep working.
* Opening Spotify from its shortcuts now always brings Spectra with it.
+ Shows that you're theming Spotify on your Discord profile (you can turn it off).
* Uninstalling puts Spotify's original shortcuts back.
* Lyrics extensions (Liquid Lyrics and others) now work in the browser.
* Themes keep working after Spotify renames its internals.
+ First release: themes, colour schemes, snippets and Spicetify extensions for the Spotify web player.
